sections.title: Consolidation Goals
items: I can consolidate Hungary's geography: location, counties, rivers and cities.
I can describe the flag, the coat of arms and the Holy Crown.
I can name Hungary's neighbouring countries.
I can review this unit's vocabulary and grammar (van/vannak, postpositions, -ból/-ből áll, határos).
